dt: Last deadline Jul 2025; NASA plans to release ROSES-27 no later than January 2027
e: NASA had said ROSES-26 would come out in July 2026; on Oct 20, 2026 it announced that ROSES-27 will be released no later than January 2027. The FY27 request cuts Astrophysics R&A sharply.
unv: NASA has not said whether ROSES-27 will include ATP or when it will be due.
